name: Motorcycle
description: A motor vehicle with a seat or saddle designed to travel on no more than three wheels, other than a tractor, all-terrain vehicle or moped. An electric one whose motor produces more than 5 brake horsepower (3,730 W) is a full motorcycle rather than a motor driven cycle. Defined by O.C.G.A. §40-1-1(29) and regulated by §§40-6-310 through 40-6-315.
restrictions: A seat or saddle, and no more than three wheels on the ground
Its motor produces more than 5 brake horsepower (3,730 W); one at or under that is a motor driven cycle
Riders need a Class M license, issued at 17 or older
A Class M instruction permit is available at 17, or at 16 after a driver education course, and isn't valid with a passenger, on a limited-access highway or at night
Riders and passengers must wear a helmet meeting the commissioner of public safety's standards, and eye protection unless it has a windshield
Riders must wear footwear, and may carry a passenger only on a seat designed for one, with footrests
Handlebars no more than 25 inches above the seat
Registered and plated, with the liability insurance required of a motor vehicle
Headlights and taillights must be on at all times
Entitled to a full lane; no passing in the same lane or riding between lanes, and no more than two abreast
